name: Lifestyle Spotlight
controllingIdea: The right location transforms a house into a lifestyle.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A property at this address offers more than square footage
narrativeArc.risingAction: Explore the dining, commute, parks, and daily conveniences
narrativeArc.crisis: Buyers overlook location data that changes everything
narrativeArc.climax: The Life Here score reveals the true lifestyle value
narrativeArc.resolution: This is not just a home - it is the life you have been looking for

triggerMoments.moment: Agent wants to showcase neighborhood advantage

questions.question: What do you love most about this location?
questions.purpose: Agent's authentic perspective on the area
questions.placeholder: The walkability is incredible - coffee shops, dinner spots, and a great park all within 10 minutes...

questions.question: Who is the ideal buyer for this lifestyle?
questions.placeholder: Young professionals who want to ditch the car, foodies who love trying new spots...

questions.question: Any standout feature about this specific property?
questions.placeholder: Rooftop terrace with downtown skyline views, 2-car garage for weekend adventures...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a data-driven lifestyle showcase. Use the Life Here location intelligence to create compelling, specific content about the area. Weave real data points (scores, restaurant counts, commute times) naturally into the narrative. Do not just list numbers - tell the story of what daily life looks like here.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Confident, specific, data-backed but conversational. Use real numbers to build credibility. Paint the lifestyle picture with concrete details, not vague promises.

slideStructure.contentFocus: Overall score and what it means
Restaurant count, top cuisines, dining score
Who thrives here - help viewer self-identify
Want the full Life Here report? DM me.

usageHints: Best when Life Here data is available for the address
Use real scores and numbers from the location API
Great for listings where location is the primary selling point
Pair with property photos that show the surrounding area

exampleScenarios.title: Downtown Orlando Condo
exampleScenarios.situation: New listing in a walkable downtown area with great dining and nightlife
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: This condo at 123 Rosalind Ave scores 87 on Life Here. 52 restaurants within walking distance, 15 min to the airport, 8 parks nearby.

expectedOutput.hook: 87 out of 100. That is what life looks like here.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: 52 restaurants. 8 parks. 15 minutes to the airport. All from your front door.
